input.width: dynamic (24-160px, scaled to preserve crop aspect ratio)

decode: greedy CTC: argmax per timestep, collapse consecutive repeats, drop blank

extraction.note: whole-card crops labelled with the full digit string (no per-glyph segmentation)

validation.note: Superseded the single-character mean-pool+argmax model and the BowCardDetector.cpp per-glyph-classify-then-glue heuristic. See end-to-end pipeline validation (boat detect -> card detect -> CTC read) against dataset-acanat26 ground truth: 26/32 = 81.2% full-string match on a 25-image random sample, including correct multi-digit reads (e.g. '38', '34', '37', '19', '16').
